artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, yellow, red and brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure with one knee raised and an arm resting on it, while the other arm supports the head. The person has a long face with a beard and long wavy brown hair. Wrapped around their head is a green crown of thorns, and they have a faint, red circular halo behind them. Their attire is minimal, consisting of a cloth draped around their waist. The background features a simple, stylized landscape with green hills. Above them is a wooden cross, partially visible, with a sign at the top. To the left of the cross, ropes hang down, one holding a tied bundle. These elements are enclosed within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure with a halo being interacted with by two individuals. The central figure appears calm and composed while seated on a rectangular platform. Flanking this central figure, there are two figures engaged in actions. One is holding a scepter and the other is holding a leaf-like object near the central figure. The scene is enclosed within a simple rectangular frame with diagonal lines suggesting the ground. There is a column of old script text on the right written in a Gothic style. The drawing has an aged, sepia-toned patina with visible signs of wear and age.

artworks.title: Morris Dancer
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.dimensions:
image/block: 12 × 8.3 cm (4 3/4 × 3 1/4 in.)
sheet (unevenly trimmed): 15.2 × 13 cm (6 × 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a figure standing on a grassy mound in a three-quarter profile view, facing left. The figure has a raised hand and features a mustache, shoulder-length wavy hair, and a green hood. They wear a yellow tunic with red buttons, ruffled cuffs, and red trims. Green leggings, red shoes, a sword at the waist, and a background of an archway with flowers and plants complete the scene.

artworks.title: The Trinity
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, orange, yellow, green, white, black, gold, and silver
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. The central figure is wearing a crown and a decorative robe, holding a smaller figure on a cross beneath them. The smaller figure has long hair and a beard, with outstretched arms, wearing a cloth around the waist. A third smaller figure is between the arms of the central figure, with a halo above. The background is adorned with geometric patterns and vibrant colors, framed by a border.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, green,vermilion, brown, yellow, tan, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures engaged in a gathering or conversation. The illustration depicts an intimate scene, where a collection of haloed figures sit closely together, some holding books or scrolls. The figures are dressed in robes of various colors, predominantly reds, blues, and whites, with some of the individuals showing expressions of focus and engagement. There is a structural backdrop with vertical columns, suggesting an interior setting. The style resembles an illuminated medieval manuscript, with detailed and vivid depictions of religious or communal scenes. The color palettes and outlines add to the medieval and narrative quality of this piece.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, green, yellow, blue, gold, and red-orange
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a bearded man standing upright. He has a solemn facial expression, prominent eyes, and a beard. His hair is long and wavy, partially covered by a large dark circular halo. He is wearing a long, flowing red robe over a lighter garment. The man holds a large wooden X-shaped cross in his left hand and a green book in his right hand, with both hands. The background consists of a simple grassy area at the bottom and a light sky with hints of blue. There is a column of text to the left of the figure.

artworks.title: Saint Conrad of Constance
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, green,yellow, blue, gold, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a slightly angled position, depicted from the waist up. The person has a solemn expression and is wearing an ecclesiastical hat with green jewels. They are dressed in intricate burgundy robes with blue and cream accents, including a large brooch on the chest. In one hand, they hold a chalice with a textured object on top, while the other hand supports it. They also carry an ornate staff on the left side. The background consists of blue brush strokes on an off-white backdrop, with a thin orange frame bordering the image.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher [recto]
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown and yellow on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (irregular fragment): 14.1 x 9.9 cm (5 9/16 x 3 7/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 31.8 x 25.4 cm (12 1/2 x 10 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a saint carrying a child across a river in a medieval architectural setting. The scene shows a figure walking through water with a child on their shoulder. The figure's robe has intricate patterns in red hues. On the left, there is a medieval town or church structure with a figure reaching out. The artwork features strong black outlines and minimal color, resembling early woodcut prints or religious iconographies. The style is reminiscent of an early Renaissance artist with medieval aesthetics.

artworks.title: Christ on a Goldsmith's Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (irregular fragment): 14.1 x 9.9 cm (5 9/16 x 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a partially visible architectural element with a hand and a chalice. The image consists of a fragmented piece of paper with ink sketches primarily on its right side. A hand is depicted extending from the right edge of the image, holding a chalice with a distinct base. Above this, there are architectural-like shapes. The overall style appears delicate and aged, with the paper showing signs of wear, such as tears and stains. Intricate line work adds detail to both the architectural elements and the chalice.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, blue, green, yellow, gold, and orange
artworks.description: The image features a person standing with a sword in their left hand and their right hand resting on the sword's sheath. They have long, wavy blonde hair, a serene facial expression, a blue robe with a brownish-red cloak, and a large halo-like object above their head. The background shows abstract clouds in blue, green grass or ground, and a small structure resembling a castle or tower. The image is framed in an orange outline.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, red lake, green, yellow, white, orange, and silver or gold
artworks.description: The image shows a figure from the waist up standing with the head slightly turned to the right. The figure has short, curly hair and a beard, wearing a halo. They are dressed in a red robe and hold a book in the left hand and a large quill or feather in the right hand. The background has a blue backdrop with a stylized border, with the figure standing against a short stone wall with grass in front.

artworks.title: The Three Women at the Tomb [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash heightend with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures facing an angel figure above. The angel is perched on a tomb with light rays emanating from its head. The figures wear long robes with cloaks covering their heads. One figure has their back turned, another holds a container, and the third holds a circular object. All figures have halos. The background consists of rocky terrain with vegetation and a cloudy sky with rays of light. The style is detailed with shading for depth and texture.

artworks.title: The High Priest before Pilate [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures in a historical setting. The scene depicts a gathering of individuals in an architectural interior with columns and arches. The figures are dressed in flowing robes and distinctive headwear. The painting uses a monochromatic palette dominated by shades of grey and black with white highlights. The figures are engaged in various poses, suggesting conversation or interaction.

artworks.title: Alphabet for a Primer
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an alphabet and syllable chart. The image features a chart with the Latin alphabet in both uppercase and lowercase letters, alongside decorative border designs. Below the letters, there are sections indicating vowels, diphthongs, and consonants, with corresponding examples. The chart is bordered with decorative patterns, and there is an area in the lower right with text labeled "Oratio Dominica."

artworks.title: Libyan Sibyl
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a regal position, with her body turned slightly to the side. She has delicate facial features, long, wavy hair, and is wearing an ornate crown. She is adorned in richly decorated clothing and is holding an open book in her lap, with one hand resting on its pages. The background is minimal, with some grass-like elements at the base, and Latin text is written around her.

artworks.title: Jesus Attracting the Faithful to Heart
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow, green, brown, red lake, and olive brown
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 12.7 x 18.1 cm (5 x 7 1/8 in.)
overall (external frame size): 31.8 x 39.4 cm (12 1/2 x 15 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting three figures against a simple background. On the left, a robed figure stands next to a tree, holding a shell-shaped object and conversing with a small, horned creature. In the center stands a small figure with horns and goat-like legs, holding two whips made of branches with red ribbons on top. On the right, another being holds a similar whip and is tied to a column, draped with a piece of cloth and shown with an expression of suffering. Speech scrolls with text in a Gothic script surround the figures. Small red pom-poms decorate parts of the image. The artwork is in the style of an unknown Renaissance artist, possibly illustrating a religious or moral allegory.

artworks.title: Allegory on Death
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing with macabre and allegorical motifs. It features skeletal and classical elements. The central design includes two putti on an arch with a skull emblem and a skeletal figure below. Flanking the arch are obelisks with Latin inscriptions. Below, there is a segmented wheel with scenes or symbols, encircled by Latin phrases. Near the bottom, an altar-like structure with Latin inscriptions, skulls, and bones suggests the theme of mortality. The artwork seems to be influenced by Renaissance memento mori imagery.

artworks.title: The Embalming of Christ
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, blue, green, yellow, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures surrounding and attending to an unclothed, reclining human figure. The figures have halos around their heads. The central reclining figure is the focal point, with others showing varied expressions. The colors are muted and earthy, with ink outlines defining each form. The style is reminiscent of the Master of the Playing Cards, known for medieval woodcut prints. The scene portrays a somber and reverent tone.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows Mocked by a Soldier
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure and a person kneeling. The image depicts a man sitting on a raised platform, with a solemn expression and wearing a crown of thorns. His hands are clasped together, and he is partially covered by a draped cloth. Another man kneels before him, pointing towards him with a stick or thin rod, gesturing emphatically. The drawing is highly detailed with strong lines and shading that create depth and texture. The entire scene is surrounded by a cloud-like form at the bottom.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, light rose, and yellow on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an intricately drawn medieval style illustration featuring four individuals. One central figure is seated, draped in white textured robes with red patterns, a long beard, and a halo. Surrounding them are three standing individuals with varied postures and attire. The left figure has a crown, beard, and ornate cloak in a profile pose. Another figure is reaching across to the central figure, while the third is below, dressed in a simple tunic and gesturing upwards. The individuals hold slender, pointed objects above the central figure. The background is a checkerboard pattern of green and black squares, bordered by red and green designs in a decorative frame.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands [recto]
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in lavender, rose, green, yellow, brown, blue, and red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows various people within an architectural setting. One central figure has a halo, wearing a long robe with long hair and a beard. Five other individuals surround this central figure; one person in pink is seated on a decorated platform washing their hands in a basin, helped by another person in green. The remaining figures wear brightly colored garments and hats, standing behind the central figure. The background features an arched structure and patterned flooring.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo [verso]
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in lavender, rose, green, yellow, brown, blue, and red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image contains a group of people from head to toe. In the center, there is a figure wearing a crown of thorns with a red and yellow halo. This figure is partially clothed with a red robe, standing under a structure, and has visible marks on the skin. Surrounding them are several other standing figures. The person to the right of the central figure is dressed in green garments and wearing a turban. The others in the group are dressed in robes of varying colors such as blue, pink, and yellow, some with head coverings. The background includes architectural elements, like an arched canopy and patterned flooring beneath the central figure, with a plain background behind the other people.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi Set in a Border
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, lt. green, brown, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting of a decorative religious scene with figures surrounded by elaborate foliage. The image displays individuals dressed in traditional robes within swirling green vines and foliage patterns forming ornate circular frames. The figures appear to be involved in religious or ceremonial activities, as depicted by their gestures and the presence of a halo around one figure who is seated with an infant. The style suggests it is likely from the medieval period, marked by flat figures, bold outlines, and typical of early European art. It resembles illuminated manuscripts or woodcut illustrations from the late medieval period.

artworks.title: Saint Bonaventure Arriving and Preaching in Lyon
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in vermilion, orange-rose, light and dark gray-blue, and lavender
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with multiple figures and iconography. The image is divided into sections, with the upper part featuring a circular mandorla containing central figures surrounded by an aureole of red and blue flames or rays. The figures within the mandorla are seated in a throne-like setting with adjoining banners, accompanied by celestial beings on either side and symbolic animals at the corners, including a winged lion. The central section of the drawing includes a prominent emblem with the letters "IHS" surrounded by angelic figures and decorative scrollwork. Below, the scene depicts an outdoor setting amidst architecture resembling a historic cityscape, with spired buildings and hilly landscapes in the background. A variety of figures, some seated and some standing, are depicted, potentially partaking in learning or devotional activities, possibly guided by a figure representing a scholarly or monastic presence. The elements throughout are intricately detailed, connected by ornamental borders in a palette of predominantly red and muted blue tones.
